about: Lacombe County is a municipal district in central Alberta surrounding the separate City of Lacombe—not the city itself. Hamlets, farms, and lake country around Gull Lake and Buffalo Lake sit in parkland between Red Deer and Edmonton. Towns such as Blackfalds, Bentley, and Eckville remain separate municipalities. About 10,000 people live in Lacombe County.
